quote.text: No greater thing is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig; if you tell me that you desire a fig, I answer you that there must be time. Let it first blossom, then bear fruit, then ripen.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as a fig requires time to blossom, your child’s growth is a gradual process; embrace each phase as it unfolds naturally.
    • Practice patience and nurture your offspring with consistent care, understanding that valuable development cannot be rushed.
  • Leadership
    • Effective leadership, like the ripening of fruit, unfolds over time; allow your team to mature and find their strength organically.
    • Recognize that immediate results are not the goal—cultivate resilience and trust, understanding that wisdom and skill develop gradually.
  • Product Management
    • Great products are not born overnight; they require thoughtful planning, iterative development, and continual refinement.
    • Allow ideas to evolve and mature, understanding that each stage—from conception to realization—is essential for long-lasting success.
